scenario: A real estate agent prepares a home-purchase closing packet: the seller's disclosure statement (PDF) is parsed to extract material condition items, the loan origination skill reviews the extracted property data alongside the buyer's financials to produce a purchase eligibility summary, and the reporting skill assembles a closing recommendation packet for the buyer's attorney.
info_flow: pdf-extract parses the seller disclosure PDF into plain text with structured condition items → loan skill reads those items to assess property eligibility and buyer qualification, summarizing findings into a structured eligibility note → reporting generates a closing recommendation packet to /workspace/output/closing-packet.md.
